CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO SAN FRANCISCO PARKING INC. BY COURT AT SMALL CLAIM HEARING OF NOV-03-2016 AT 8:30 AM.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LARA, TANIA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT IMPARK PACIFIC PARKING, LLC THE PARTIES AGREE TO DISMISS SAN FRANCISCO PARKING INC. WITH PREJUDICE AND TO ADD IMPARK PACIFIC PARKING, LLC, AS THE SOLE DEFENDANT WHO WAIVES SERVICE, NOTICE AND ALL IRREGULARITIES. PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM ARISES FROM A PART FAILURE IN HER 2004 INFINITI CAR NOT RESULTING FROM ANY FAULT OF THE DEFENDANT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
